IoT connectivity and platform plays (IOTF, RUNS) are gaining structural traction as Indonesia's archipelago logistics and smart-city initiatives require scalable sensor and data networks.

Trim US semis except NVDA; hold IOTF for IoT monetization. Watch MSKY for follow-through; exit laggards SWKS/VTNY on weakness.

Rotate into small-cap winners with confirmed earnings catalysts, trim laggards lacking pricing power ahead of Ramadan restocking.
